ModuleTitle.helper: Administrator-facing title for this module. This syncs with DNN module settings and does not display to visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used for #anchor-links on the page. Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionHeading.helper: Optional. Main heading shown above the card grid. HTML is allowed.
SectionHeading.placeholder: Explore solution paths by operational need.

IntroText.helper: Optional. Short intro shown below the heading. HTML is allowed.
IntroText.placeholder: Find deployable computing, capture, analysis, and mission-support solutions built for field, edge, and operational environments.

Cards.helper: Add service cards in display order. Icon mode preserves the existing icon layout. Image mode shows a top card image.

VisualType.helper: Choose whether this card uses the existing icon treatment or a full-width top image.

IconClass.helper: Optional. FontAwesome icon class. Used only when Icon Image is empty.

IconImage.helper: Optional. Small icon image shown above the card title. Takes priority over Icon Class.

CardImage.helper: Top image for this card. Recommended: landscape image with a clear focal point.

CardImagePosition.helper: Controls which part of the source image remains visible when the card crop uses object-fit: cover.

Title.helper: Required. Card title. HTML is allowed.

Description.helper: Required. Short supporting description. HTML is allowed.
Description.placeholder: We validate every delivery to reduce risk and ensure stable, reliable experiences.

Link.helper: Optional. If a link is added, the entire card becomes clickable.
